description: Adds a price label for the product page; the bug changes getPrice from cents to dollars, which the unchanged checkout still charges as cents, the clean diff converts to dollars only inside the label.

bug.scenario: checkout(gateway, 'mug', 2) in the unchanged src/checkout.ts multiplies getPrice('mug'), now 12.5 dollars, by 2 and passes 25 to gateway.charge(amountCents), so the customer is charged 25 cents instead of $25.00.

clean.why_safe: getPrice still returns cents, so checkout charges 2500 for two mugs; only priceLabel divides by 100 for display.
